decision: Keep the deployed baseline. The 0.0692-percentage-point validation gain is too small to justify replacing the release without fresh full-pipeline/independent evidence. Prioritize species-data coverage rather than another blind mask-training loop.
scope: Validation development comparisons. GPU mask-helper mean time is not full CPU p95. No new independent test, inference-accuracy or absence-of-overfitting guarantee.
checks: Unique complete 40-reference ID coverage for each of 9 configurations
Every mean recomputed from per-image CSV
Plan SHA and effective detector/segmenter/SAM identities agree with candidate policies
Selection is actual highest measured mean IoU
